_about: Public-domain William Charles Edmund Newbolt (1844-1930), canon of St Paul's and principal of Ely Theological College, for the Word Hoard: his books of sermons, addresses and pastoral theology, among them Penitence and Peace, Counsels of Faith and Practice, Speculum Sacerdotum, The Prayer-Book, Quiet Days and Retreats, The Gospel of Experience, Priestly Ideals, Religion, handbooks to St Matthew and St John, Words of Exhortation, The Dial of Prayer, Apostles of the Lord, Priestly Blemishes, The Cardinal Virtues, The Church Catechism, Fundamental Christianity, The Sacrament of the Altar, The Holy Eucharist, Confirmation, The Ministry of the Word, The Fruit of the Spirit, Christian Marriage at the Cross-Roads, and his recollections, Years that are Past. He lived until 1930; every book taken was printed before 1930. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 112 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
